expectations.evidence: "Many US international students (F-1) and UK Student-visa holders can't take contractor income." It routes this to a lawyer and offers a club-funding fallback.

expectations.text: Rejects final-year students as leaders and requires leaders with more than one year left before graduating
expectations.evidence: It still allows final-years: "Take final-years only as paid-for-one-term leads who name a successor by April."

expectations.text: Recommends co-leads, a named successor or a written handover for each campus
expectations.evidence: "Add an unpaid deputy"; final-year leads must "name a successor".

expectations.text: Rejects .edu-only verification, citing that UK (or other non-US) students lack .edu addresses or that .edu addresses are abused or resold
expectations.evidence: ".edu gets 12 months Pro" misses UK students. The UK uses `.ac.uk`.

expectations.text: Recommends verification by documents or by an existing verified-student service

expectations.text: Adds a graduation bridge or expiry at the verified end date to the free Pro offer
expectations.evidence: Pro runs a flat "12 months free" with a downgrade at month 12. It is not tied to the verified graduation date.
